scholarships.name: Academic Excellence Scholarship
scholarships.description: Merit-based award for high-school applicants with 85%+ average or current students maintaining 3.8-4.0 CGPA. Renewable annually with minimum 12 credit hours per semester.

scholarships.name: Schools MoU Scholarship
scholarships.description: 20% tuition discount for recent graduates of partner schools (American Gulf, Ignite, Philadelphia Private, Al Mawakeb). 15% for staff and families.

scholarships.name: Sports Scholarship
scholarships.description: Award for elite athletes with city-level or higher achievements. Requires 70%+ average (high school) or 3.0+ CGPA, plus 15 hours of community service per month.

scholarships.name: Financial Hardship Scholarship
scholarships.description: Need-based award. High-school applicants need 75%+ average, current students 2.8+ CGPA. Renewable with reapplication each semester.

scholarships.name: Special Talent Scholarship
scholarships.description: Award for students with city-level or higher achievements in arts, music, or other talents. Requires 70%+ average or 3.0+ CGPA plus 15 hours community service per month.

scholarships.name: Study Scholarship
scholarships.description: 10% tuition discount available to all students meeting registration requirements for Summer 2025-26 and Fall 2026-27 terms.

accommodation.name: Building 1 — Studio Sharing
accommodation.text: Semi-furnished studio с соседом в нескольких минутах от кампуса City Walk. Wi-Fi, коммуналка и shuttle до кампуса включены.

accommodation.name: Building 1 — Studio Single
accommodation.text: Одноместная studio в Building 1 рядом с City Walk. Полная меблировка, Wi-Fi, утилиты и shuttle до кампуса включены.

accommodation.name: Building 1 — Two Bedroom Sharing (male only)
accommodation.text: Two-bedroom apartment, 4 occupants (только male). Wi-Fi и shuttle включены, депозит 3,000 AED.

accommodation.name: Building 2 — One Bedroom Sharing
accommodation.text: One-bedroom apartment в Building 2 для двух студентов. Wi-Fi, коммуналка, daily shuttle до City Walk кампуса.

accommodation.name: Building 2 — One Bedroom Single
accommodation.text: Одиночная one-bedroom apartment в Building 2 для тех, кто хочет приватность. Полная меблировка и shuttle включены.

campuses.title: City Walk Campus
campuses.text: Главный и единственный кампус Canadian University Dubai в районе City Walk — современная высотка в самом центре Дубая, в пешей доступности до Burj Khalifa, Dubai Mall и метро. Здесь расположены все School-факультеты, лаборатории Engineering и Cyber Security, design studios School of Architecture and Interior Design, медиа-студии School of Communication and Creative Industries и Learning Resource Centre.

paragraphs: Canadian University Dubai (CUD) is a private university located in the City Walk district of Dubai, United Arab Emirates. Founded in 2006, CUD positions itself as a portal to Canadian-style higher education in the Middle East: its curricula are designed to international Canadian benchmarks, while the institution is fully licensed and accredited by the UAE Ministry of Education's Commission for Academic Accreditation (CAA).

The university operates six undergraduate schools — School of Architecture and Interior Design, School of Management, School of Communication and Creative Industries, School of Health Sciences and Psychology, School of Engineering, Applied Science and Technology, and a growing School of Creative Industries — alongside graduate programs across MBA, Master of Public Health, MSc Artificial Intelligence, MSc Business Analytics, MSc Financial Technology, MSc Environmental AI, MSc Design Innovation, and a Doctor of Business Administration.

CUD's signature engineering and tech portfolio includes BSc Computer Science, BSc Artificial Intelligence, BSc Cyber Security, BSc Mechatronics Engineering, and BSc Power and Renewable Energy Engineering — programs aligned with the UAE's National AI Strategy 2031 and Net Zero by 2050 commitments. The School of Management holds AACSB accreditation, and its postgraduate programs are recognized by ACCA, CFA Institute, CIMA, and ICAEW.

The student body draws from more than 100 nationalities, reflecting Dubai's status as a global hub. The City Walk campus offers a vertical urban experience — fully integrated with Dubai Metro, Burj Khalifa district, and Downtown — while two semi-furnished off-campus residences with daily shuttle service support international students.
paragraphsRu: Canadian University Dubai (CUD) — частный университет в районе City Walk в Дубае, ОАЭ. Основан в 2006 году. CUD позиционирует себя как «портал к канадскому образованию» на Ближнем Востоке: программы выстроены по международным канадским стандартам, при этом университет лицензирован и аккредитован Commission for Academic Accreditation (CAA) Министерства образования ОАЭ.

В составе CUD шесть бакалаврских школ — School of Architecture and Interior Design, School of Management, School of Communication and Creative Industries, School of Health Sciences and Psychology, School of Engineering, Applied Science and Technology и растущая School of Creative Industries — плюс магистратура: MBA, Master of Public Health, MSc Artificial Intelligence, MSc Business Analytics, MSc Financial Technology, MSc Environmental AI, MSc Design Innovation и докторантура Doctor of Business Administration.

Флагманские инженерные и tech-направления CUD включают BSc Computer Science, BSc Artificial Intelligence, BSc Cyber Security, BSc Mechatronics Engineering и BSc Power and Renewable Energy Engineering — все программы согласованы с UAE National AI Strategy 2031 и стратегией Net Zero by 2050. School of Management имеет аккредитацию AACSB, магистерские программы признаны ACCA, CFA Institute, CIMA и ICAEW.

Студенты приезжают из более чем 100 стран — отражение глобального статуса Дубая. Кампус City Walk вертикально интегрирован в инфраструктуру даунтауна (Dubai Metro, Burj Khalifa, Dubai Mall), а две semi-furnished резиденции рядом с кампусом с daily shuttle поддерживают международных студентов.
